scope: One fresh certified movement-only baseline evaluation on original two-opponent state

managedAcceptance.refundsAndCap: Move, stay and already-moved CT refunds; real changed readiness order versus Attack
managedAcceptance.score: Zero, negative, both actor identities and closed extrema; unchanged HP/status/facing/death counters
managedAcceptance.clock: Highest CT, source slot ties, modulo and an already-ready opponent without tick addition
managedAcceptance.rng: One upkeep draw, no formula draws, explicit carry/replay, exact-MAX success and exhaustion
managedAcceptance.admission: Each false source certificate, unavailable or terminal state, score certificate and invalid destination
managedAcceptance.isolation: Collection order, immutable input/live RNG and atomic rejection without partial outcome

limits: Caller certificates do not authenticate unrepresented original context
Fresh source score-cell provenance required; unvisited/stale cells are not inferred
No complete original scenario-scoring RNG schedule or native VSync resume
No scenario generation, ranked list/lottery, decision interface or gameplay activation
receiptPolicy: Identify this implementation by the Git commit containing this evidence; no routine current-file hash freeze
